name: camus-cli
description: A coding loop that proves every change. Claude writes it, Codex (a competitor) reviews it, your own tests decide. No agent grades its own work.

scripts.test: bash -c 'cd skills/camus/scripts && for t in test_adapter.py test_verify.py test_env_check.py test_prep.py test_resume_scan.py test_review_audit.py test_status.py test_steer.py; do python3 $t || exit 1; done && bash test_guard.sh && cd ../../.. && python3 test_merge_settings.py && node test_hitl_workflows.js'
